{"code": "# Filter for CONTROL-arm patients with MODERATE severity
df_control_moderate = df[(df['arm'] == 'control') & (df['severity'] == 'moderate')]

# Check how many have biomarker_baseline == -999.0
sentinel_count = df_control_moderate[df_control_moderate['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0].shape[0]

print(f'Number of CONTROL-arm MODERATE patients with biomarker_baseline = -999.0: {sentinel_count}')

# Check response rate among those with valid baseline
valid_baseline = df_control_moderate[df_control_moderate['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0]
response_fraction = valid_baseline['responded'].mean()

print(f'Fraction responded (excluding sentinel values): {response_fraction}')

# Also check if any other sentinel values exist in 'responded' or other key fields
print(f"Any invalid 'responded' values? {df_control_moderate['responded'].isin([0,1]).all()}")"}
